UserPrivateProfile.title: UserPrivateProfile
UserPrivateProfile.description: Private Google-authenticated user profile isolated under users/{userId}/private/info.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the path userId.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync/sign-in.

DownloadHistoryItem.title: DownloadHistoryItem
DownloadHistoryItem.description: A downloaded media record synced to the user's Google account across devices.

id.description: Unique download entry ID matching document ID.

name.description: Saved file name shown in download history.

enName.description: Optional English label for localized display.

isAudio.description: True if the saved file is audio-only.

createdAtMs.description: Client creation epoch milliseconds for stable cross-device ordering.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp verified on creation.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: PII-isolated private user profile stored strictly at docId 'info' and readable/writable only by the verified owner.

/users/{userId}/downloads/{downloadId}.description: Synced download history entries owned by {userId}, protected by UID equality and strict field validation.
